response.original_title: [[FAQs!@cruise]]How to combine two Trips in MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To combine two trips on MSC Cruises, you are usually creating what is called a back-to-back cruise, where you sail two consecutive itineraries one after another ☏ +1-877-619-8065 or +1-877-619-8065 (UK). This can be on the same ship or sometimes between two connected sailings ☏ +1-877-619-8065 or +1-877-619-8065 (UK). The process depends on whether MSC sells it as one longer itinerary or as two separate cruises ☏ +1-877-619-8065 or +1-877-619-8065 (UK).
